title: RMIT researchers turn cigarette butts into bricks, reducing firing energy use by 10%
summary_full: Researchers are developing methods to recycle discarded cigarette butts into lightweight bricks. This innovative approach aims to reduce environmental pollution from cigarette waste. Incorporating butts into bricks can also lower energy requirements during production. The research explores collecting and processing cigarette filters on an industrial scale. This initiative could significantly decrease litter and manufacturing costs globally.
